title: Trajectory First: A Curriculum for Discovering Diverse Policies
abstract: arXiv:2506.01568v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Being able to solve a task in diverse ways makes agents more robust to task variations and less prone to local optima. In this context, constrained diversity optimization has become a useful reinforcement learning (RL) framework for training a set of diverse agents in parallel. However, existing constrained-diversity RL methods often under-explore in complex tasks such as robot manipulation, resulting in limited behavioral diversity. We address this with a two-stage curriculum that introduces a spline-based trajectory prior as an inductive bias to produce diverse, high-reward behaviors in an initial stage, and then distills these behaviors into reactive, step-wise policies in a second stage. In our empirical evaluation, we provide novel insights into challenges of diversity-targeted training and show that our curriculum increases the diversity of learned skills while maintaining high task performance.

translated_title: 轨迹优先：发现多样策略的课程学习法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2506.01568v4 公告类型：替换 摘要：能够以多种方式解决任务使智能体对任务变化更加鲁棒，且不易陷入局部最优。在此背景下，约束多样性优化已成为一种有用的强化学习（RL）框架，用于并行训练一组多样化的智能体。然而，现有的约束多样性强化学习方法在复杂任务（如机器人操作）中往往探索不足，导致行为多样性有限。我们通过一个两阶段课程来解决这一问题：第一阶段引入基于样条轨迹的先验作为归纳偏置，以生成多样且高奖励的行为；第二阶段将这些行为蒸馏为反应式、逐步的策略。在我们的实证评估中，我们提供了关于多样性目标训练挑战的新见解，并表明我们的课程在保持高任务性能的同时增加了学习技能的多样性。
tldr: 本文提出了一种两阶段课程学习法，利用样条轨迹先验生成多样化行为，再蒸馏为反应式策略，在复杂任务中提升行为多样性并保持高性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a two-stage curriculum that uses spline-based trajectory priors to generate diverse behaviors and then distills them into reactive policies, enhancing behavioral diversity in complex tasks while maintaining high performance.
